item.title: Helena community members trade places with Helena Public School administrators
item.description: For over a decade, the Helena Education Foundation has hosted a "Trading Places" event, where members of different businesses and organizations swap roles with someone from Helena Public Schools.

item.title: Montana political world reacts to Daines' decision to not seek reelection
item.description: In just over two days, Montana’s political scene was completely reshaped, as the state’s two longest-tenured members of Congress both dropped out of their races for reelection.

item.title: Experts weigh the political fallout after Daines drops out of U.S. Senate race
item.description: Montana Republican Sen. Steve Daines dropped his bid for re-election just three minutes before the filing deadline on Wednesday afternoon — a move that caught many Montanans off guard.
